bodyHtml:
How long have you looked at that outdated bathroom every morning? You know, the one with the leaky faucet and the rusty towel bar that’s been there since who-knows-when? It’s time to upgrade your bathroom and step into a space that makes you say, “Wow!” Prayag India offers a modern and affordable solution for your bathroom transformation, giving a modern look to your old bathroom without draining your wallet.

 Prayag India has launched its new range of PTMT SYMET bath fittings, which are sturdy, effective, and sustainable. Explore why these fittings are the perfect choice for you.

What Is PTMT Symet?

PTMT  Poly Tetra Methylene Terephthalate is a special kind of plastic known for its durability and non-rusting properties. It is strong and lightweight, making it effective for bathroom fittings. PTMT taps elevate the bathroom with their sleek and stylish look.

Why Prayag India Is A Perfect Choice For Ptmt Symet Bath Fittings?

PTMT has remarkable qualities and has many uses. This advanced plastic has had an higher effect on the plumbing and sanitary ware industry. Discover the benefits of PTMT SYMET Bath fittings:

  • Unscratchable: PTMT taps or bath fittings are designed to be scratch-proof. They can resist marks and scratches even with regular use, ensuring that your PTMT taps look shiny for a long time.
  • Longevity: PTMT taps have a longer lifespan as they can handle high temperatures, and their smooth coating prevents taps and other bathroom fittings from corrosion caused by moisture and hard water.
  • Minimal Maintaiance: PTMT taps and accessories require little effort for cleaning and maintenance. Their smooth surface prevents the build-up of dirt and mineral deposits, which maintains their shine for years.
  • Affordability: Choosing PTMT fittings for your bathroom is a money-saving decision. They provide an elegant look similar to expensive fixtures without costing too much. They last for years without repairing needs, making them a cost-effective choice.

The PTMT of Prayag India: Innovation And Design Flexibility

Prayag India offers a wide range of PTMT bathroom fixtures in different styles, shapes, designs, and colours. You can choose designs according to your preferences.

  • Advanced Material Processing: Prayag India uses the best quality materials to meet industrial standards and customer needs. They use advanced and innovative technology for their products, and each item undergoes a quality check process.
  • Double-Tone Range: Prayag India offers different double-shade PTMT bath fittings and taps, giving you comprehensive selection options.
  • Single Tone Range: Prayag India also offers single-tone PTMT bath fittings by keeping customer needs in mind, allowing you to transform your bathroom into a single-tone.

PTMT Bathroom Product Range

Prayag India deals in a wide variety of PTMT bathroom products that combine functionality and style. The range offers multiple preferences and ensures top-quality products for your bathroom.

Taps and Faucets

  • Single Lever Taps- Sleek appeal with easy temperature control.
  • Mixer Faucet- It is perfect for mixing hot and cold water.

Showers

  • Hand Showers- Adjustable and multiple spray settings for a relaxing shower experience.
  • Overhead Showers- It gives you comprehensive coverage, and you can enjoy your bath.

Valve Settings

  • Angle Valves- They accurately regulate water flow, making them perfect for residential and commercial use.
  • Stop Valves - They control water flow in the needed amount, allowing you to shut off the water supply whenever needed without disturbing the entire system.

Bath Fittings

  • These include towel racks, soap cases, toothbrush holders, toilet seats, and covers in different sizes, shapes, and colours.

Prayag India promises environment safety and sustainability

  • Water Conservation: Prayag India’s PTMT products are specially designed with the critical feature of zero drop in water wastage, which contributes to water conservation. Their leakproof faucets prevent water from being wasted once closed.
  • Sustainability: Prayag India’s PTMT products are made with sustainable materials. These products are recyclable and durable. By choosing PTMT, you can conserve the environment and enjoy high-quality and long-lasting products.

Time to Transform

It’s time to say goodbye to your boring bathroom. Enhance the look of your bathroom with Prayag India’s PTMT SYMET bathroom fittings. These fittings and products are the perfect choice for anyone looking to upgrade their bathroom at affordable prices but with a lavish vibe. Transform your bathroom today and feel the difference with Prayag India’s PTMT SYMET range.
